scope: Paper IV global D7 decision readiness and terminal classification
non_redefinition_clause: This wrapper does not alter RQIR Core v1.0, D1-D7, Tier-1 coverage semantics, terminal criteria, family-scope rules, comparator rules, or any previously frozen benchmark threshold. It only makes the prerequisites and legal D7 outputs explicit and executable/auditable.

metric_separation.operational_polygon_readiness: Measures exhaustion of internally executable high-information benchmark work. It may be 100% while D7 remains scientifically unauthorized.
metric_separation.d7_protocol_infrastructure_readiness: Measures whether the D7 decision contract, state schema, provenance requirements, and classifier logic are fully specified. It is an engineering/methodology metric only.
metric_separation.d7_scientific_authorization: Measures whether the frozen scientific prerequisites permit a terminal D7 classification. It must never be inferred from operational or infrastructure readiness percentages.
metric_separation.candidate_gravity_r3: Independent scientific readiness metric governed by external Candidate-Gravity scientific authority.

D7-S0.name: FROZEN_JUDGE_INTEGRITY
D7-S0.purpose: Verify that the judge, thresholds, family-scope rules, provenance rules, and fail-closed semantics are frozen before any global conclusion is attempted.
pass_conditions: RQIR Core v1.0 remains frozen
Paper-IV major-framework coverage contract remains authoritative
BLOCKED/PARTIAL/undefined are not converted to FAIL
scoped child outcomes are not promoted to family outcomes without an explicit family-scope proof
no post-hoc threshold relaxation or comparator substitution is introduced

D7-S1.name: INTERNAL_SATURATION
D7-S1.purpose: Verify that no scientifically justified internally executable Tier-1 closure task remains hidden behind workflow debt.
pass_conditions: Tier-2 unresolved count is zero
every nonterminal Tier-1 family has an explicit external/theory/data/authority reopen condition
internal_actionable_fronts equals zero
operational proving-ground saturation is certified without claiming scientific closure

D7-S2.name: STRICT_TIER1_TERMINAL_COVERAGE
D7-S2.purpose: Close D2A: resolve every major Tier-1 family at family scope or by exhaustive material-subfamily resolution under the frozen coverage contract.
pass_conditions: no Tier-1 row remains BLOCKED, PARTIAL_SUBFAMILY_ONLY, NOT_YET_BENCHMARKED, or otherwise unresolved
all merges are supported by explicit reduction/equivalence maps
family-level conclusions have family-level evidence

D7-S3.name: SAME_REALIZATION_OBJECT_COMPLETENESS
D7-S3.purpose: Close D2B: ensure every terminally classified realization has the required same-realization physical objects, parameter transport, normalized observable, comparator, and propagated uncertainty/error certificate.
pass_conditions: required observables belong to the same physical realization used for the claimed dynamics
microscopic/effective parameters are transported without identity swaps
normalized comparator-ready observables are present where the frozen judge requires them
theory, nuisance, covariance, and numerical errors required by the benchmark are propagated

D7-S4.name: COMMON_DOMAIN_GLOBAL_COMPARABILITY
D7-S4.purpose: Close D3/D4 at the global decision level so terminal family results are comparable on the frozen common domain.
pass_conditions: common-domain normalization is explicit
double counting and cross-family overlap are resolved by documented reduction maps
terminal evidence is compared under the same frozen decision semantics
D4 is globally closed rather than merely partial

D7-S5.name: GLOBAL_OUTCOME_CLASSIFIER
D7-S5.purpose: Emit exactly one terminal D7 outcome only after D7-S0 through D7-S4 are PASS/CLOSED.

D7-S6.name: CANDIDATE_GRAVITY_ACTIVATION_EXPORT
D7-S6.purpose: Translate an authorized D7 result into downstream action without retroactively changing the benchmark.
D7-S6.activation_rule: Candidate Gravity new-model construction is activated as mandatory only if D7-S5 returns NEW_REQUIRED. Other outputs route to the corresponding existing/adapted/hybrid development path. NOT_AUTHORIZED keeps Candidate Gravity activation false.

required: D7-S0 through D7-S4 PASS/CLOSED
at least one known-family realization is terminally sufficient under the complete frozen decision bundle
the sufficient realization does not require a material modification that would move it outside the accepted family/realization definition
global coverage/comparability has ruled out an artifact of selective benchmarking
D7-S0 through D7-S4 PASS/CLOSED
no unadapted known realization is sufficient under the complete frozen decision bundle
an explicit adaptation within a known family is fully specified and closes the frozen decision bundle
family identity, parameter transport, provenance, and new assumptions are explicit
D7-S0 through D7-S4 PASS/CLOSED
no single known or admissibly adapted family is sufficient
an explicit hybrid composition closes the complete frozen decision bundle
same-realization compatibility, reduction maps, parameter transport, and double-counting controls are demonstrated
D7-S0 through D7-S4 PASS/CLOSED
every major Tier-1 known family is terminally resolved under the frozen coverage contract
all materially distinct known subfamilies are either terminally tested or validly reduced/merged
no unresolved BLOCKED/PARTIAL major family remains
no existing realization is sufficient
no admissible adaptation of an existing family is sufficient
no admissible hybrid of known families is sufficient
D2 and D4 are CLOSED
forbidden_shortcuts: counting absence of a published object as evidence that the object cannot exist
promoting a scoped FAIL to a family FAIL
inferring NEW_REQUIRED from operational saturation alone
inferring NEW_REQUIRED from R1/R2 repository or methodology readiness
activating a novel model before the terminal classifier is authorized

fail_closed_rules: Any unresolved mandatory prerequisite forces D7-S5 to NOT_AUTHORIZED.
Any provenance conflict or same-realization identity conflict reopens the affected prerequisite rather than being averaged away.
A new external authority may reopen a parked family but does not demote prior operational saturation unless it creates a genuinely internally actionable material branch.
No percentage may substitute for a terminal scientific state.
protocol_infrastructure_completion_rule: D7 protocol infrastructure may be reported as 100% once this contract, a machine-readable current-state file, a provenance-backed stage audit, and recovery/ledger entries exist and pass repository methodology validation. This is explicitly not D7 scientific closure.
